features.description: MVP mount/unmount loop: start with explicit skills and adapter none mounts exactly those packages; finish removes the workdir and records unmounted=true
steps: Run: lunchbox start --library testdata/skills --skill demo-review --skill demo-scan --adapter none
Verify the workdir contains exactly demo-review and demo-scan
Run: lunchbox finish
Verify the workdir is gone and result.json has unmounted=true

features.description: doctor reports adapter, skill dirs, counts, menu_tokens estimate, and duplicates read-only, without mounting anything
steps: Run: lunchbox doctor against a configured fake tree
Verify skill count and estimated menu_tokens match the tree
Verify no run dir or workdir was created

features.description: TUI doctor screen: navigable doctor report behind the tui cargo feature, with a --json twin and a passing snapshot test
steps: Launch the doctor TUI against a fake tree with the tui feature enabled
Verify displayed counts/tokens equal the doctor --json output for the same tree
Verify the TestBackend snapshot test passes in CI without a terminal

features.description: TUI token-cost preview: menu_tokens for a candidate pack vs without-Lunchbox, with --json twin and snapshot test
steps: Open the preview screen for a candidate pack of two demo skills
Verify the shown run estimate equals CLI estimation for that pack and the without-Lunchbox figure equals doctor's
Verify the snapshot test passes headless

features.description: TUI skill picker: browse the library, compose a pack, start a real run, finish it — all from the screen
steps: Open the picker against testdata/skills
Select demo-review and demo-scan and start the run from the screen
Verify the run mounted exactly the selected skills
Finish the run from the screen and verify the workdir is gone

features.description: TUI policy review: view allow/deny per config layer and edit one; the edit persists to exactly that layer
steps: Open policy review in a project that has both global and project layers
Add a deny entry from the screen while viewing the project layer
Verify ./lunchbox.toml contains the entry and ~/.lunchbox/config.toml is unchanged
Verify the run resolver now denies that skill name

features.description: Pi Path A isolation: start spawns pi with --no-skills and --skill <workdir> present in argv; selftest guards flag drift
steps: Run: lunchbox start --library testdata/skills --skill demo-review --adapter pi --wait -- -- pi --list-models
Verify the audit spawn event shows --no-skills and --skill <workdir> in argv
Verify the adapter selftest passes (skipped cleanly if pi is absent)

features.description: v1 exit bar: scripted MVP CLI loop plus a human walkthrough of all four TUI screens against real state
steps: Verify feature-001 through feature-007 all pass
Perform the human walkthrough: doctor on real dirs, picker → start → finish, policy edit persisting to the right layer
Record walkthrough result and date in PROGRESS.md

features.description: v1 README per DESIGN §25: one-liner, install, doctor/start/finish quick start, menu_tokens before/after, not-a-skill-manager note, TUI section
steps: Every README command runs verbatim against a fresh clone with a temp HOME and the shown output matches
Install section names cargo install --locked --git (placeholder URL, no remote configured) and the from-a-clone path
README states it is not a skill manager and points --library at Kitter / Skills Manager / ~/.agents/skills

features.description: Omp Path A: start --adapter omp spawns omp with discovery off and the run workdir as the only skill source — or refuses Path A explicitly if isolation cannot be verified (DESIGN §13)
steps: adapters lists omp with version and a passing selftest where omp is installed, skipped cleanly where absent
start --adapter omp --dry-run prints the exact spawn argv including the per-run --config overlay whose content points skills.customDirectories at the workdir
A live spawn loads exactly the mounted skills (foreign pantry names absent), or the adapter refuses to spawn with an explicit error naming the probe result
